author: elonmusk
text:
Elon is not for cartels of state capture.

He is pro-human and he doesn’t want AI that’s destroying humans.

A lot of us see Elon as the hope against the AI cartel, and I think he is still fighting it.

Saying “we should be careful not to wipe out part of the economy by releasing a model that can do a lot of damage without any safety” is not the same as “we need to be regulated and the state should capture AI.”
